name: io.github.pepu-org/pepu
description: MCP server for building on Pepe Unchained (PEPU) V2 with @pepu-chain/sdk: chain facts, contract registry, bundler/paymaster/sponsorship probes, error and tx explanation, template scaffolding, env and Privy checks, session policies, calldata and project-transaction encoding, bundled docs and SDK snippets, plus pepuscan (Blockscout) and RPC lookups. Not a generic Blockscout wrapper.
title: Pepe Unchained (PEPU)
